project_inclusion.note: Locally useful look-alike; strict native-status filtering deferred.

morphology_keys.life_cycle: Annual or short-lived perennial depending on treatment/conditions.
morphology_keys.habit: Twining vine with long flexible shoots.
morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate, large, heart-shaped; often 3-lobed; densely to moderately hairy.
morphology_keys.sepals: Usually about 16–17 mm in Williamson County material, lanceolate and hairy.
morphology_keys.corolla: Large trumpet-shaped flower, around 5–7 cm or more across/long in local material; often blue-violet aging pinkish.
morphology_keys.key: Much larger flower than I. hederacea and I. triloba; hairy foliage and long sepals.
